def bands_of(g,bg):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    rows=[i for i in range(h) if any(x!=bg for x in g[i])]
    out=[];cur=[rows[0]]
    for i in rows[1:]:
        if i==cur[-1]+1: cur.append(i)
        else: out.append(cur);cur=[i]
    out.append(cur)
    return out

def patt(g,r,bg): return {c for c in range(len(g[0])) if g[r][c]!=bg}

def best_shift(pa,pb,w):
    best=max(sum(1 for c in pa if 0<=c+s<w and (c+s) in pb) for s in range(-w,w))
    return best

def transform(g, refsel='touch'):
    g=[r[:] for r in g]; h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    bg=Counter(x for r in g for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    bs=bands_of(g,bg)
    touch=[b for b in bs if any(g[r][w-1]!=bg for r in b)]
    if refsel=='touch': refs=touch or [bs[0]]
    elif refsel=='top': refs=[bs[0]]
    targets=[b for b in bs if b not in refs]
    # global shift: mode over ref/target row pairs
    shifts=[]
    for tb in targets:
        for k in range(min(len(refs[0]),len(tb))):
            ra=refs[0][k]; rb=tb[k]
            pa,pb=patt(g,ra,bg),patt(g,rb,bg)
            if pa and pb:
                sc=[s for s in range(1,w) if sum(1 for c in pa if c+s<w and (c+s) in pb)==best_shift(pa,pb,w)]
                shifts+=sc
    s=Counter(shifts).most_common(1)[0][0]
    for tb in targets:
        for k in range(min(len(refs[0]),len(tb))):
            ra=refs[0][k]; rb=tb[k]
            pa,pb=patt(g,ra,bg),patt(g,rb,bg)
            if not pa or not pb: continue
            rbm=max(pb)
            for c in pa:
                cc=c+s
                if cc<w and g[rb][cc]==bg and cc>rbm: g[rb][cc]=1
    return g

for i,p in enumerate(pairs):
